messages:
ana_csm: Weekly health check for Echelon. Focus: p95/p99 by route & model, streaming vs non-stream. Quick summary: total calls +9%, streaming p99 on /complete-chat with redwood-65b up noticeably. Table below.

ana_csm: ```
Route | Model | Mode | p95(ms) | p99(ms)
/complete-chat | redwood-65b | streaming | 370 | 760
/complete-chat | redwood-65b | non-stream | 240 | 480
/summarize | llama-7b | streaming | 150 | 300
/summarize | llama-7b | non-stream | 120 | 220
/vec | embed-v1 | n/a | 80 | 140
```

chris_cs_eng: That's visible. Did Echelon change client behavior?

ana_csm: They enabled a multi-turn preview feature last week; avg tokens per request up by ~25. Started ramp yesterday.

sam_infra: Infra notes: KK cache hit for redwood-65b streaming dropped from 74% -> 49% around 2026-04-02 11:00 UTC. Two older stream-hosts reported elevated swap.

jia_sre: Error rate steady at 0.35%. No 5xx surge. But queue length for streaming peaked at 16 for short windows. Will add watch rule threshold.

raj_runtime: Likely cause: longer prefixes + streaming working set increases memory churn. Recent kernel rollout (kopt-2c) could have larger mem footprint for streaming. Short-term: migrate Echelon streaming to newer hot-pool nodes and increase stream-worker mem on a few hosts. Medium-term: test a quantized streaming variant.

sam_infra: I'll migrate flows to hot-pool now. Command: ```bash
infractl migrate --customer echelon --route /complete-chat --mode streaming --pool echelon-hot --wait 20m
```

ops-bot: migration started (op-id: mig-1101).

ana_csm: Action items: 1) sam_infra  migrate and post KV hit after 30m. 2) raj_runtime  schedule 5% quantized streaming canary tomorrow and run quality checks. 3) chris_cs_eng  prep a short customer note explaining steps and ETA.

sam_infra: Migration done. KV hit recovered to ~70% on hot pool. Early latency update: p95 streaming 370 -> 320ms, p99 760 -> 530ms.

jia_sre: Added SLO watch: page if streaming p99 > 700ms for >20m. Triggered briefly during migration but cleared.

raj_runtime: Canary scheduled 2026-04-04T09:00Z (id: qcan-115). Will collect 2h window and post p95/p99 + quality delta.

chris_cs_eng: Drafted customer note: "We observed higher tail on streaming during your recent multi-turn rollout. We routed streaming to higher-memory hosts and are running a canary. Expect follow-up with numbers in 24-36h." Sending after canary results.

ana_csm: Renewal/risks: usage rising and tail is customer-visible. Risk medium until canary proves stable. If p99 > 700ms persists for another week, propose scheduling an exec check-in.

sam_infra: KV back to baseline across hosts. No swap observed after migration.

raj_runtime: Canary started; collecting metrics. Will post results in thread when ready.

ana_csm: Thanks all. Please update here with canary numbers and any customer-ready screenshots for the note."
